title: Dinner, Drinks and Games Night! (Karaoke Later On!)
description:
\*\*We will be exploring new restaurants each month! Make sure to answer this event's question, as I need to make booking at the restaurant for exact number of people on Saturday. In case, if there is additional space, it can be filled by people on the waiting list.
Also, if you wanna just attend for board games, that's fine too. Just make sure to let me know by answering this event's question. Thanks!\*\*

Hey everyone!

The time has arrived for another evening of Dinner, Board Games and Drinks! The plan is to meetup for dinner, drinks and socializing at
**Ramen Do - Japanese Noodle Bar on Symonds street** at **6 PM** and then, head off to Cakes and Ladders at **6:55 PM** for some board gaming action.

After jamming board games until 9:30 PM, we will head off to a Karaoke Bar. 8 spots max for Karaoke.

RSVP and come on over. Have a good meal, get acceptably intoxicated (optional), make new friends (and old!) and play some games!

**Other details:**

* Cakes & Ladders is a few meters away from the restaurant on the opposite side of the street.
* Cakes & Ladders charges $5 an hour.
* To support this awesome board gaming place, go ahead and order something to drink or eat. (Optional)
* Make sure to bring in your identity proof along with you. Either Passport or NZ Driver's license. Physical copy is required and digital copies will not be accepted at bars and Clubs.
* Finally, for whatever reason, if you RSVP and can no longer make it to the event, change your RSVP by Friday 10 PM so that people on the wait list can fill your space instead. No-Show members will be marked accordingly and potentially banned from future events.

If you are lost or unable to find the group, text or call me on 0221 762 752 and I will be happy to help out. See you all then!

Join us on facebook for more events related to game nights, movies, sci-fi and socializing. [https://www.facebook.com/groups/SocialGeekNZ/](https://www.facebook.com/groups/SocialGeekNZ/)

Regards,
Raziq

title: 0x25 Auckland Meetup at AUT CSI
location: 74 Governor Fitzroy Place, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
**WHAT TO EXPECT**
Join us for another Hack The Box meetup in Auckland! Whether you're thinking about being a hacker or are already a seasoned one, this event has something for everyone.

**A massive shoutout to AUT Cyber Security & Intelligence (CSI) Club for opening their doors to us and sponsoring the event venue and catering.**

The event will include a guided walk through of a security challenge, demonstrating essential tools and techniques for enumeration, exploitation, and privilege escalation. Attendees will have the opportunity to network and collaborate with other members.

At the end, we will do a raffle where we will give out HTB prizes, such as VIP access to the platform and HTB Academy cubes.

This is an on-site event in Auckland CBD.

**WHAT YOU GET**

* A chance to win some HTB giveaways
* Access to our HTB dedicated lab during the event

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* A laptop.
* A HTB account.
* Discord application.

**HOUSE RULES**

* Follow all rules and guidelines in the **[HTB TOS: HTB Terms of Service](https://www.hackthebox.com/tos)**
* Active HTB content cannot be shared publicly. Retired challenges or machines are fair game.
* **AUT CSI Club** host the event to support the growth of the local cybersecurity community and to support students and professionals in their journeys to learn. Respect for the venue and people is expected from all attendees.

**ADDITIONAL NOTES**

* Join our Discord for event discussion, upcoming event announcements, and CTFs here: **[https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu](https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu)**
* Free parking is not available at the location.

**CODE OF CONDUCT**
We strive to create a safe, welcoming, and inclusive environment for all attendees. To ensure a positive experience for everyone, the following behaviors are strictly prohibited:

* Smoking
* Drinking alcohol
* Any form of discrimination or racism
* Any other forms of misconduct

Any attendee found engaging in these behaviours will be immediately banned and permane

title: On Body and Soul (Hungary 2015, 1 hr 50)
description:
I am really excited about showing this film. It was nominated for the Academy Aaward for Best Foreign Language Film and won the Golden Bear Award at the Berlin International Film Festival.

The film depicts a romance in which two people share a re-occuring dream - that they are a pair of deer in a forest. The film is beautifully shot (you will love deer after this). A lot could be said about this film, but it takes us into world of autism and socially damaged indiividuals

The Fictionmachine reviewer wrote "technically it is superb. Cinematographer Máté Herbai turns every shot into a beautifully composed painting. The film’s use of colour is superb. The scenes of the two deer are remarkable to watch, and capture the animals in such an emotive fashion."

Some won't get it, but nothing new in thw world of cinema there!

title: Bush walk through Chelsea Reserve
description:
This weekend we'll take to the bush paths in Chelsea Heritage Park. There will be plenty of steps and challenging sections. Aprox 10Km distance.
High level of fitness is required and shoes with a good grip & ankle protection recommended. Walk includes some steep stairs up and down.

What to bring:

Sun and rain protection
Plenty of water and a snack
Sturdy closed shoes with a good grip
Something to sit on for snack stop (optional)
Hiking poles (optional)

Members only, no children, pets, smoking or vaping

You're welcome to make a voluntary donation to help cover the fees we pay meetup...If you would like to make a donation please make it by online banking rather than cash.
Suggested donations are $2 per walk or $10 per year.
Banking Account:
Weekend Walks
38-9026-0763672-00
Thanks for your support! 🙂

Meetup groups like this one are run by volunteers who would like to relax and enjoy the event as much as other participants. As such we expect everyone to take responsibility for themselves as we are not liable for any personal loss or injury at any event. By RSVP ing "Yes" you accept that you have read all the details of the trip and that you participate at your own risk. Therefore, for your own safety and enjoyment and that of others please do not sign up for an event unless you know that your abilities are well within the level of fitness and agility required for it.
If you want to bring a friend to an event, they need to sign up to this group so that they have the same understanding as above. Also, there are limited spaces for our trips and so many members, so we have a policy that only members can come.
